{{Quote|Perhaps you have heard of Darth Ikoral&mdash;a great man of pure Sith blood, decorated by the Emperor and honored for his might. Ikoral lived like royalty a century ago, in a time when purebloods carried unparalleled prestige and the Empire remained hidden.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
'''Darth Ikoral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the decades before the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Born into an [[Darth Ikoral's lineage|old line]] of red-skinned, pureblooded Sith, Ikoral was able to trace his ancestry almost as far back as [[Sith King|King]] [[Adas]]'s [[Reign of the Ax|time]]. Ikoral survived many battles and trials, even earning the notice of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself, which Ikoral claimed was proof of pureblood superiority. Supposedly Ikoral was so devoted to his views that he refused to tolerate [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in his household. He was the [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] of the Sith Lord [[Darth Vindican]].

Around [[3712 BBY]], Ikoral convinced the [[Dark Council]] to allow an expedition to search for pureblooded Sith outside the Empire, hoping to find Sith who fled [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] who had not made the journey to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] with the Sith Emperor. When Ikoral failed to return from his quest, he was celebrated as a martyr; for decades his name was synonymous with determination and sacrifice in the Sith Empire.

The truth, however, was that Ikoral had indeed succeeded in his search. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Darth Ikoral returned with thousands of pureblood Sith. But the Empire had changed much in Ikoral's seventy-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] absence. Appalled by the Empire's [[Treaty of Coruscant|peace]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and sickened by the appearance of aliens in the Sith ranks, Darth Ikoral led his fellow purebloods to cleanse the galaxy by force of violence.

The response to Ikoral's quest was the dispatching of a strike team to eliminate him. After boarding his flagship, the ''[[Red Reaper]]'', the strike team found Ikoral in his personal sanctum and [[Battle of the Red Reaper|engaged]] him in combat. The attackers soon found out that he had experimented on the purebloods and increased his power. The strike team, however, ultimately proved more powerful and killed Ikoral at the behest of [[Darth Malgus]], who was apprenticed to Darth Vindican, of whom was in turn a former apprentice of Ikoral.
